suggestion: Add a single site-wide navigation strip shared by every dashboard, generated from one list.
problem_it_solves: Each existing dashboard has its own hand-maintained nav, so sections drift and a visitor cannot tell which page is current.
risk_if_adopted: A shared nav touches every page, so one bad edit breaks all of them.
decision_owner_needs: Agreement from every session that owns a dashboard, because this is a shared output.
detail_and_limits: Recommended as a final-integration change only; no session should edit another session's pages unilaterally.

suggestion: Stamp every page with the exact source-read timestamp and a content hash of the CSV it renders.
problem_it_solves: A reader cannot tell whether a table is five minutes or five months old.
risk_if_adopted: Hashes must be regenerated on every build or the page lies.
decision_owner_needs: Nothing beyond the builder; already partly implemented here.
detail_and_limits: This pack already emits a build timestamp and per-file SHA-256 on the Sources page; extending it to older pages needs their owners.

suggestion: Add a per-row confidence column that distinguishes 'computed from official inputs' from 'verified by an official statement' from 'unverified'.
problem_it_solves: Readers currently see a source link and assume the value behind it is certified.
risk_if_adopted: Three labels invite argument about which applies to a borderline row.
decision_owner_needs: Agreement on the three labels and their definitions.
detail_and_limits: This pack uses exactly three states: verified, computed, unverified. A blank cell is never silently zero.

suggestion: Publish the originated line next to a market line and show the difference.
problem_it_solves: An originated line with nothing to compare against cannot support a decision.
risk_if_adopted: Requires a licensed odds feed, which does not exist.
decision_owner_needs: A licensed odds provider and a written right to display prices.
detail_and_limits: Deliberately not done. Showing a market price without a licence would breach the terms read for this pack.

suggestion: Show the incoming replacement player's depth string as a fourth value next to the injury status.
problem_it_solves: The single biggest gap in the depth screen: 46 of 49 entries cannot state who took the snaps.
risk_if_adopted: Depends on an official depth chart that is not always published in machine-readable form.
decision_owner_needs: Confirmation of which official depth-chart source is authoritative.
detail_and_limits: The Recommended Next Data Purchases section explains how to close this gap.

suggestion: Render the ten gates as a live checklist per strategy, not as prose.
problem_it_solves: A reader cannot see which specific gate stopped a strategy.
decision_owner_needs: Nothing; implemented in this pack's Strategies page.
detail_and_limits: Each strategy row lists passed, blocked and failed gates with their identifiers.

suggestion: Publish the leaderboard as an empty, explicitly labelled competition frame with the reward tiers defined before any result exists.
problem_it_solves: Fixing reward tiers after seeing results is a classic way to manufacture apparent skill.
risk_if_adopted: A permanently empty table can look like a defect.
decision_owner_needs: None; the tiers are defined in validation.py and documented here.
detail_and_limits: Pre-registering the tiers is the point: the reward rule must predate the results.

suggestion: Keep tables semantic, avoid hover-only information and give every page one h1.
problem_it_solves: Hover-only tables and multiple h1 elements are unusable with a screen reader.
decision_owner_needs: Nothing; enforced by the checker for this pack.
detail_and_limits: The checker asserts exactly one h1 per page, no input elements, and a source link on every row.

suggestion: Add a Flagged for Review page that lists every unverified item with the exact source a reviewer should read.
problem_it_solves: Unverified items currently hide inside tables.
detail_and_limits: Every flag in this pack carries the official URL a reviewer should open.

suggestion: Add a root LICENSE and a data-rights statement separate from code licensing.
problem_it_solves: Public visibility is not a licence, and the earlier repository audit already flagged the missing LICENSE.
risk_if_adopted: Choosing a licence is an owner decision that must not be automated.
decision_owner_needs: An explicit owner decision on code licence and on third-party data rights.
detail_and_limits: The existing audit finding A-F15 remains open and is referenced, not resolved, by this pack.

suggestion: Add a single Decision Readiness page that answers, in one screen, what can and cannot be decided today.
problem_it_solves: Requirements and data gaps are scattered across many pages.
detail_and_limits: The landing page carries this summary; the Questions page carries the itemised version.

suggestion: Guard every generated dashboard with a rebuild-and-diff check in CI.
problem_it_solves: Hand-edited generated pages silently diverge from their data.
risk_if_adopted: A legitimate manual fix will fail CI until the data are changed instead.
decision_owner_needs: Nothing; the repository already does this for other dashboards, and this pack follows the pattern.
detail_and_limits: python3 scripts/check_nfl_3b81013c.py rebuilds and diffs every page.
